text.p: Firstbank of Illinois Co said on Monday it agreed to acquire BankCentral Corp for Firstbank common stock and cash totaling $13.2 million.
BankCentral is a holding company for Central National Bank of Mattoon, Ill. and has assets of about $112 million.
Firstbank reported assets of $1.92 billion at September 30.
About 50 percent of the purchase price will be in Firstbank common stock, Firstbank said in a statement.
The proposed transaction, which requires approval by regulators and BankCentral shareholders, is expected to close in March or April, it said.

"The acqusiition of Central National gives Firstbank an immediate, significant market presence in Mattoon and Coles County, Illinois," said Mark Ferguson, Firstbank chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Shares of Firstbank were off 3/16 to 33-1/16.
